text: The tired dog slept under the kitchen table.
ir: (assert (e1 sleep :tense past :subj (m1 dog :det the :adj tired) :obl-under (m2 table :det the :compound kitchen)))

text: Maria bought a new bicycle yesterday.
ir: (assert (e1 buy :tense past :subj (m1 Maria :propn) :obj (m2 bicycle :det a :adj new) :adv yesterday))

text: My sister works at a small bakery.
ir: (assert (e1 work :tense pres :subj (m1 sister :poss (m2 I :pron)) :obl-at (m3 bakery :det a :adj small)))

text: The soup is very hot.
ir: (assert (e1 be :tense pres :subj (m1 soup :det the) :attr (hot :adv very)))

text: There are three apples in the bowl.
ir: (assert (e1 be :tense pres :there :subj (m1 apple :det three :num pl) :obl-in (m2 bowl :det the)))

text: The window was broken by a baseball.
ir: (assert (e1 break :tense past :voice pass :subj (m1 window :det the) :obl-by (m2 baseball :det a)))

text: Tom gave the neighbor a jar of honey.
ir: (assert (e1 give :tense past :subj (m1 Tom :propn) :iobj (m2 neighbor :det the) :obj (m3 jar :det a :obl-of (m4 honey))))

text: The children are playing quietly in the garden.
ir: (assert (e1 play :tense pres :aspect prog :subj (m1 child :det the :num pl) :obl-in (m2 garden :det the) :adv quietly))

text: Sam's brother is a nurse.
ir: (assert (e1 be :tense pres :subj (m1 brother :poss (m2 Sam :propn)) :attr (m3 nurse :det a)))

text: The train will arrive at noon.
ir: (assert (e1 arrive :tense fut :subj (m1 train :det the) :obl-at (m2 noon)))

text: We painted the old fence on Saturday.
ir: (assert (e1 paint :tense past :subj (m1 we :pron) :obj (m2 fence :det the :adj old) :obl-on (m3 Saturday :propn)))
notes: PP 'on Saturday' attached to the verb; noun attachment is grammatically possible but not a real competing reading, so no :ambig.

text: Robin sent the manager a long email.
ir: (assert (e1 send :tense past :subj (m1 Robin :propn) :iobj (m2 manager :det the) :obj (m3 email :det a :adj long)))

text: The museum closes early on Sundays.
ir: (assert (e1 close :tense pres :subj (m1 museum :det the) :obl-on (m2 Sunday :propn :num pl) :adv early))
notes: Day name treated as a plural proper noun (Sundays).

text: A cold wind blew across the empty field.
ir: (assert (e1 blow :tense past :subj (m1 wind :det a :adj cold) :obl-across (m2 field :det the :adj empty)))

text: These shoes are too small.
ir: (assert (e1 be :tense pres :subj (m1 shoe :det these :num pl) :attr (small :adv too)))
notes: 'too' treated as an intensifier adverb on the adjective.

text: The letter was written by my grandmother.
ir: (assert (e1 write :tense past :voice pass :subj (m1 letter :det the) :obl-by (m2 grandmother :poss (m3 I :pron))))

text: Alex has finished the report.
ir: (assert (e1 finish :tense pres :aspect perf :subj (m1 Alex :propn) :obj (m2 report :det the)))

text: The baby is sleeping upstairs.
ir: (assert (e1 sleep :tense pres :aspect prog :subj (m1 baby :det the) :adv upstairs))

text: There was a long line outside the pharmacy.
ir: (assert (e1 be :tense past :there :subj (m1 line :det a :adj long) :obl-outside (m2 pharmacy :det the)))
notes: PP attached to the existential verb rather than to 'line'; the two analyses do not differ in meaning here.

text: The farmer sold us fresh eggs.
ir: (assert (e1 sell :tense past :subj (m1 farmer :det the) :iobj (m2 we :pron) :obj (m3 egg :num pl :adj fresh)))

text: Every seat on the bus was taken.
ir: (assert (e1 take :tense past :voice pass :subj (m1 seat :det every :obl-on (m2 bus :det the))))
notes: 'was taken' annotated as a passive (surface form), though it is close to adjectival/stative.

text: The mechanic quickly repaired the engine.
ir: (assert (e1 repair :tense past :subj (m1 mechanic :det the) :obj (m2 engine :det the) :adv quickly))

text: The library is next to the post office.
ir: (assert (e1 be :tense pres :subj (m1 library :det the) :obl-next_to (m2 office :det the :compound post)))

text: Maria's cat caught a tiny mouse.
ir: (assert (e1 catch :tense past :subj (m1 cat :poss (m2 Maria :propn)) :obj (m3 mouse :det a :adj tiny)))

text: The bridge was built in 1932.
ir: (assert (e1 build :tense past :voice pass :subj (m1 bridge :det the) :obl-in (m2 1932)))
notes: Year written as a bare mention with the numeral as head.

text: Our neighbors are moving to Canada.
ir: (assert (e1 move :tense pres :aspect prog :subj (m1 neighbor :num pl :poss (m2 we :pron)) :obl-to (m3 Canada :propn)))

text: The teacher read the class a funny story.
ir: (assert (e1 read :tense past :subj (m1 teacher :det the) :iobj (m2 class :det the) :obj (m3 story :det a :adj funny)))

text: Some birds were singing loudly outside.
ir: (assert (e1 sing :tense past :aspect prog :subj (m1 bird :det some :num pl) :adv loudly :adv outside))

text: This old sweater belonged to my father.
ir: (assert (e1 belong :tense past :subj (m1 sweater :det this :adj old) :obl-to (m2 father :poss (m3 I :pron))))

text: The tickets are in the blue envelope.
ir: (assert (e1 be :tense pres :subj (m1 ticket :det the :num pl) :obl-in (m2 envelope :det the :adj blue)))
notes: Locative copula: PP complement of 'be' as :obl-in (spec silent; :attr reserved for adjective/NP complements).

text: Sam will call the plumber tomorrow.
ir: (assert (e1 call :tense fut :subj (m1 Sam :propn) :obj (m2 plumber :det the) :adv tomorrow))

text: The cake was eaten before lunch.
ir: (assert (e1 eat :tense past :voice pass :subj (m1 cake :det the) :obl-before (m2 lunch)))
notes: 'before' with an NP is a preposition, so :obl-before, not the clause relation :before.

text: The nurse brought the patient a glass of water.
ir: (assert (e1 bring :tense past :subj (m1 nurse :det the) :iobj (m2 patient :det the) :obj (m3 glass :det a :obl-of (m4 water))))

text: Many people visit the lake in summer.
ir: (assert (e1 visit :tense pres :subj (m1 person :det many :num pl) :obj (m2 lake :det the) :obl-in (m3 summer)))

text: The car is parked behind the hotel.
ir: (assert (e1 park :tense pres :voice pass :subj (m1 car :det the) :obl-behind (m2 hotel :det the)))
notes: Stative 'is parked' annotated as a passive (surface-faithful); could alternatively be be + :attr parked.

text: Robin is a talented musician.
ir: (assert (e1 be :tense pres :subj (m1 Robin :propn) :attr (m2 musician :det a :adj talented)))

text: The kettle has been whistling for a minute.
ir: (assert (e1 whistle :tense pres :aspect perfprog :subj (m1 kettle :det the) :obl-for (m2 minute :det a)))

text: The waiter poured the wine carefully.
ir: (assert (e1 pour :tense past :subj (m1 waiter :det the) :obj (m2 wine :det the) :adv carefully))

text: No customers came into the shop.
ir: (assert (e1 come :tense past :subj (m1 customer :det no :num pl) :obl-into (m2 shop :det the)))
notes: Negation expressed by determiner 'no', not clause :pol.

text: Those flowers need sunlight.
ir: (assert (e1 need :tense pres :subj (m1 flower :det those :num pl) :obj (m2 sunlight)))

text: The meeting was canceled by the director.
ir: (assert (e1 cancel :tense past :voice pass :subj (m1 meeting :det the) :obl-by (m2 director :det the)))

text: Maria can speak four languages.
ir: (assert (e1 speak :mod can :subj (m1 Maria :propn) :obj (m2 language :det four :num pl)))

text: The puppy was lying on a soft blanket.
ir: (assert (e1 lie :tense past :aspect prog :subj (m1 puppy :det the) :obl-on (m2 blanket :det a :adj soft)))

text: The museum's new exhibit is extremely popular.
ir: (assert (e1 be :tense pres :subj (m1 exhibit :poss (m2 museum :det the) :adj new) :attr (popular :adv extremely)))

text: There is a spider on the ceiling.
ir: (assert (e1 be :tense pres :there :subj (m1 spider :det a) :obl-on (m2 ceiling :det the)))

text: Alex lent Sam an umbrella.
ir: (assert (e1 lend :tense past :subj (m1 Alex :propn) :iobj (m2 Sam :propn) :obj (m3 umbrella :det a)))

text: The river flooded the village during the storm.
ir: (assert (e1 flood :tense past :subj (m1 river :det the) :obj (m2 village :det the) :obl-during (m3 storm :det the)))

text: The students should read the first chapter.
ir: (assert (e1 read :mod should :subj (m1 student :det the :num pl) :obj (m2 chapter :det the :adj first)))

text: Tom rarely drinks coffee.
ir: (assert (e1 drink :tense pres :subj (m1 Tom :propn) :obj (m2 coffee) :adv rarely))

text: A package was delivered to the wrong address.
ir: (assert (e1 deliver :tense past :voice pass :subj (m1 package :det a) :obl-to (m2 address :det the :adj wrong)))
